parts.label: (a)
parts.text: On the diagram of abscisic acid, use an asterisk (*) to label each chiral carbon atom.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Abscisic acid is reacted with an excess of $\text{NaBH}_{4}$.

Give the molecular formula of the organic product formed.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: If abscisic acid is treated with an excess of hot, concentrated, acidified $\text{KMnO}_{4}$, three different carbon-containing products are formed.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: Draw the skeletal formula of the carbon-containing product with the **largest** molecular mass.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Identify the carbon-containing product with the **smallest** molecular mass. Explain how this product arises.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text: Identify the third carbon-containing product of this reaction by giving its displayed or structural formula.
